milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate close to the redstone torch (at spawn-relative [0, 2, -5] on the cobblestone pillar) and face it, confirming visual identification. A max_distance of 5 blocks ensures the player has actively navigated toward the torch (not just standing at spawn), and facing_tolerance of 60° confirms they are looking at it rather than passing by coincidentally.
